sections.title: Camera, movement and interpolation
items: Keep the selected field at the attention center through the close-up and dropdown. Animate menu scale from its attachment point, and move surrounding UI only as much as the reframe needs.

Use separate curves for position, orientation and scale. An intermediate pose should not force a full stop unless the reference visibly pauses. Judge the projected silhouette and screen velocity, not just whether handles are Bézier.

sections.title: Lighting, materials and focus
items: High-key white studio treatment. Use a near-white background, large soft area lights, restrained contact shadow and a narrow edge reflection for dark product rims. Keep lime or accent emissions from washing out white UI text.

The background form softens when the payment menu is foregrounded. Isolate the menu from the background blur; its options must remain readable. Distinguish circular cursor rings from the processing spinner.
Lighting descriptions name the visible treatment and an inferred reconstruction. Original light powers, lens, aperture, shutter and compositing settings are unknown unless explicitly recorded below.

sections.title: Construction controls and implementation order
items: Block the incoming and outgoing states first. Establish the main object trajectory, then schedule child actions and reading intervals. Add focus and exposure blur after the trajectory is intelligible. The following controls are a build plan, not measured source settings.

tables.caption: Native construction controls
rows: Masked digit columns or explicit numeric updates with a fixed currency symbol and baseline.
Separate container and options; animate clipping/scale from the pay field.
One selected option with an explicit state transition.
Animate rotation/progress independently of status text and global opacity.

sections.title: Transitions, failure modes and review
items: The processing state becomes payment success beside a globe.
A dropdown that fades in as a flat screenshot cannot reproduce its spatial attachment. Do not blur the selected menu along with the inactive form.

Review this excerpt with both adjacent joins at normal speed, then diagnose at half speed. Check first-visible frames, accidental stops, silhouette clipping, text readability and outgoing blur. A contact sheet does not establish perceptual smoothness or audio quality.
